description: Source code for a high-precision anti-aliasing renderer in the FreeType project, implementing exact coverage calculations for font outline rendering.

classes.name: gray_TWorker
classes.description: Structure representing the state of the anti-aliasing rasterizer, including outline, cell tables, clip box, and rendering parameters.

classes.name: gray_TRaster
classes.description: Structure representing the raster object, mainly holding a memory pointer.

methods.name: gray_move_to
methods.description: Move to a new position in the outline, starting a new contour.

methods.name: gray_line_to
methods.description: Render a line segment to the current position.

methods.name: gray_conic_to
methods.description: Render a conic (quadratic) Bezier curve segment.

methods.name: gray_cubic_to
methods.description: Render a cubic Bezier curve segment.

methods.name: gray_render_span
methods.description: Render a span of coverage on the target bitmap.

methods.name: gray_sweep
methods.description: Process all cells to generate gray spans for the target bitmap.

methods.name: gray_convert_glyph_inner
methods.description: Decompose outline into segments and process cells for a glyph.

methods.name: gray_convert_glyph
methods.description: Main function to convert an outline glyph into a rasterized bitmap.

methods.name: gray_raster_render
methods.description: Render an outline into a bitmap using the anti-aliasing rasterizer.

methods.name: gray_raster_set_mode
methods.description: Set raster mode (no-op in this implementation).
